archetypes.name: dyn-lint-engine-contracts
archetypes.rationale: New shared lint engine owns path containment, syntax policy, and suppression contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect python/larch/lint/engine.py for root verification vs nested work-trees, symlink containment escapes, fail/skip syntax-policy ordering before detect, same-line tokenize-based suppression including empty-reason errors, buffered stdout so later ScanError cannot leak partial findings, and deterministic dedupe/sort/render. Cross-check tests in python/tests/lint/test_lint_engine.py cover those branches. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
